subject: general
question:
The given line graph shows the sale of a shopkeeper (in thousands) from the year 2016 to 2022. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cf12e8740e587b71a88e1f859f208592514a4eef128c740727516054e25edec.png] 

The sale in 2020 is what percentage of sale in 2021?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Sales in 2020 = 450.

Sales in 2021 = 880.

According to the question

⇒ 450/880 × 100 = 51.13%

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
